title: Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with $O(d)$ Regret
abstract: arXiv:2609.13440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We give a deterministic algorithm for online inverse linear optimization with regret $O(d)$, uniform in the horizon and $O(d^{2})$ time per round. A bound of this order was obtained recently by Dewasurendra, settling a question of Gollapudi et al.\ and of Oki and Sakaue, but by an improper rule that enumerates covers at every scale and costs $T^{\Theta(d)}$ a round; ours is the first efficient such bound and the first proper one. We build on the variable-metric framework of Sakaue et al., adding a self-normalized rank-one update, and we replace the $\log\det$ potential by the trace power $\tr(H^{-1/2})$, which is bounded outright and removes the $\ln T$. The bound also holds against an expert that does not optimize, and we give corruption-robust and rank-adaptive variants, and an application to convex minimization.

translated_title: 具有 $O(d)$ 悔恨度的高效在线逆优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于在线逆线性优化的确定性算法，其悔恨度为 $O(d)$（与时间范围无关），每轮时间复杂度为 $O(d^{2})$。最近 Dewasurendra 获得了这一量级的界，解决了 Gollapudi 等人以及 Oki 和 Sakaue 提出的问题，但其采用的规则是不恰当的，需要在每个尺度上枚举覆盖，每轮代价高达 $T^{\Theta(d)}$；而我们的方法是首个实现此类高效界的方法，也是首个恰当的方法。我们基于 Sakaue 等人的变度量框架，增加了自归一化的秩一更新，并用迹幂 $\tr(H^{-1/2})$ 替代 $\log\det$ 势函数，该函数直接有界，从而去除了 $\ln T$ 项。该界在对抗不进行优化的专家时同样成立，我们还给出了抗腐蚀和秩自适应的变体，以及在凸最小化中的应用。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个高效且恰当的确定性在线逆线性优化算法，通过与每轮轮数无关的 $O(d)$ 悔恨度和每轮 $O(d^{2})$ 的时间复杂度，利用自归一化秩一更新和迹幂势函数解决了此前方法每轮指数级开销的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first efficient and proper deterministic algorithm for online inverse linear optimization, achieving horizon-uniform $O(d)$ regret with $O(d^{2})$ per-round time via a self-normalized rank-one update and a trace-power potential that resolves the exponential per-round cost of prior methods.
